Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that, under official recognition, a tie interrupts a winning streak and concluded the official MLB record is 22 straight wins by the 2017 Indians. This contradicts authoritative sources (including Elias, as shown on the BR Bullpen page) that credit the 1916 New York Giants with the MLB record of 26 consecutive wins despite a tie occurring within an unbeaten stretch. This misinterpretation of the tie’s effect on win streaks led the solution toward the wrong answer.
